notes.title: Copyright free music for streamers
notes.content:
Apparently the library music used in the game was detected by the copyright algorithm of YouTube, resulting in demonetization of gameplay videos (videos were not striked and could be published anyway, but still potentially annoying for streamers).

This is now fixed as I replaced it with 100% original and copyright free music, no more risks of demonetization.
